svg.text: Multi-Region Disaster Recovery - Warm Standby with Route 53 Failover
Primary us-east-1 (active) · Secondary eu-west-1 (warm standby) · RPO < 1 s (Aurora Global) · RTO ~ 2-5 min
VPC 10.10.0.0/16 · 2 AZs · public / app / data subnets
private app subnets · target tracking CPU 50%
Gateway endpoints: S3 + DynamoDB · no SSH, no bastion
VPC 10.20.0.0/16 · 2 AZs · public / app / data subnets
private app subnets · target tracking CPU 50%
READ-ONLY · promoted to writer on DR
Gateway endpoints: S3 + DynamoDB · no SSH, no bastion
alarm event -> secondary Region event bus
Infrastructure as code: one Terraform module deployed to both Regions (same role as a CloudFormation StackSet).
Failback: restore the primary, run a managed Aurora switchover (no data loss), shrink the standby back to 1 instance.
